stage_reports.goal: Identify the active July 5 failure-hardening objective and verify that the current workline artifact no longer matches the newest handoff.
stage_reports.outcome: The newest handoff moved to July 5 failure hardening while the live current-workline artifact still pointed at the July 4 discovery-failover line.

stage_reports.goal: Measure the concrete breakage classes that still let CHIMERA leave mixed state, skip listener self-heal, or overwrite valid operator intent.
stage_reports.outcome: The highest-value gaps were non-transactional external install state, transparent runtime UID/GID overwrites, a broken primary port sensor that could suppress listener self-heal, recorded local-bin drift, and still-open false-green publication semantics.

stage_reports.goal: Choose the smallest truthful package that hardens shared failure boundaries without broad speculative refactoring.
stage_reports.outcome: The chosen slice was install/update transactionality, operator-intent preservation, shared listener-port sensor fallback, and contract evidence, while leaving publication-truth and remote reboot/rebind proof explicitly open.

stage_reports.goal: Run the required interdisciplinary council across install/update rollback, publication truth, stale artifacts, reboot recovery, and source trust.
stage_reports.outcome: The council converged on widening the rollback boundary to external operator state, preserving valid operator intent, and keeping the remaining false-green and stale-artifact risks explicit as open blockers.

stage_reports.goal: Place the fixes at the smallest shared control boundary that affects install/update and listener self-heal paths.
stage_reports.outcome: External-state snapshot and restore were centralized in install_release, the installer kept ownership of settings preservation and existing runtime defaults, and listener occupancy fallback stayed in the shared probe helper used by node preflight.

stage_reports.goal: Implement external-state rollback, preserved transparent runtime IDs, resilient listener-port probing, and recorded local-bin reuse, then add explicit negative-path contract coverage.
stage_reports.outcome: The code now snapshots external operator state before installer mutation, restores it on failure, preserves transparent runtime UID/GID/exempt UID when valid, reuses the recorded local-bin target across updates, and falls back from broken `ss` listener probes to the next available sensor so fixed-port self-heal still arms runtime auto-listen overrides.

stage_reports.goal: Verify the new failure-hardening package locally without touching CHIMERA runtime or network state on the current PC.
stage_reports.outcome: Syntax checks passed; start, stop, update, and installer contract bundles passed; session-process-guard passed; the local proof now covers broken-sensor listener self-heal in addition to install/update rollback and preserved operator settings.

stage_reports.goal: State what the July 5 line really closes and what must remain open until remote proof or deeper freshness work lands.
stage_reports.outcome: Install/update mixed-state failure classes and broken-sensor listener self-heal failures are materially reduced, but publication truth, stale artifact precedence, remote reboot persistence, and live rebind continuity remain open and block any pass claim.

fundamental_principles_checked: do not promote partial proof to pass
per_role_checks.transfer_principle: Widen the rollback boundary to the full external operator state so a failed install cannot leave behavior half-new and half-old.
per_role_checks.rejected_analogy_reason: A broad refactor-first approach was rejected because it would expand change surface without first closing the shared failure boundary.

fundamental_principles_checked: fresh state must beat stale cache
shared resolver should own freshness rules
per_role_checks.transfer_principle: Do not let raw cached endpoint files outrank validated fresh control-plane state; if freshness matters, resolution belongs in a single verified loader.
per_role_checks.rejected_analogy_reason: Direct shell jq parsing was rejected as a final authority because file shape alone is not enough to preserve endpoint causality.

per_role_checks.transfer_principle: Every hardening claim needs a paired negative-path proof showing that stale state, misleading success, and secret leakage are rejected instead of merely not discussed.
per_role_checks.rejected_analogy_reason: Happy-path-only validation was rejected because it would miss the exact mixed-state failures that triggered this workline.

fundamental_principles_checked: mixed external state must fail closed
per_role_checks.transfer_principle: Rollback and source selection are both trust boundaries: preserve valid operator intent, but never silently widen the authority set or accept half-restored state.
per_role_checks.rejected_analogy_reason: Implicit source expansion was rejected because availability improvement is not allowed to change trust semantics by accident.

fundamental_principles_checked: recovery is not proved until the loop closes remotely
service green must match runtime truth
per_role_checks.transfer_principle: Boot recovery and port-conflict repair are only complete when the packaged release survives reboot and peers actually consume the fresh endpoint without manual repair.
per_role_checks.rejected_analogy_reason: Local service plumbing was rejected as sufficient proof because it does not establish remote closed-loop recovery on the stand.

fundamental_principles_checked: background recovery intent is not health truth
stale carryover must not stay green
per_role_checks.transfer_principle: Do not report healthy runtime when only a future background reconcile might repair publication; degraded truth must remain visibly degraded until actually repaired.
per_role_checks.rejected_analogy_reason: A green orchestrator with partial publication was rejected as acceptable because operator-visible health cannot be inferred from intended future recovery.

subagent_execution_log.prompt_summary: Architect prompt summary: audit the July 5 failure-hardening line for install/update transactionality, operator intent preservation, degraded publication truth, and the exact proof boundary needed before any pass claim.
subagent_execution_log.output_summary: Architect output summary: verdict PARTIAL; transactional restore and intent preservation are accepted, but the workline still needs a July 5 attestation, remote reboot/rebind proof, and stricter truth around auto-reconcile publication semantics.

subagent_execution_log.prompt_summary: Senior developer prompt summary: inspect mesh publication, auto-bind, and stale artifact handling to identify the smallest safe code boundary that reduces silent mixed-state and self-heal drift.
subagent_execution_log.output_summary: Senior developer output summary: verdict PARTIAL; install/update hardening can proceed now, but shell auto-bind still trusts cached endpoint-shaped files too early and needs validated freshness or a CLI-owned resolver.

subagent_execution_log.prompt_summary: Tester prompt summary: define the strongest negative-path contract bundle for failure hardening, covering rollback, redaction, stale state, false-green health, and release reinstall behavior.
subagent_execution_log.output_summary: Tester output summary: verdict PARTIAL; the new rollback/install contracts are good, but status, doctor, and rollback text still need explicit negative tests against stale artifacts, misleading success, and secret leakage.

subagent_execution_log.prompt_summary: Security prompt summary: inspect update-source trust, rollback safety, and operator-state preservation for failure hardening, and identify where wrong authority or mixed external state can still win.
subagent_execution_log.output_summary: Security output summary: verdict PARTIAL; external-state rollback and preserved settings are the right direction, but bootstrap metadata trust and undeclared authority expansion remain open until source binding is tightened.

subagent_execution_log.prompt_summary: DevOps prompt summary: audit reboot recovery, service lifecycle coupling, port-conflict rebind continuity, and the evidence needed to prove the packaged release recovers cleanly on the SSH stand.
subagent_execution_log.output_summary: DevOps output summary: verdict PARTIAL; local lifecycle plumbing exists, but reboot persistence, post-rebind peer continuity, and remote closed-loop recovery are still unproven and must stay open blockers.

subagent_execution_log.prompt_summary: Critic prompt summary: challenge the July 5 failure-hardening line for false-green health, stale carryover, and any path where background recovery intent can mask a broken current state.
subagent_execution_log.output_summary: Critic output summary: verdict PARTIAL; the work is safer than before, but auto_reconcile can still leave publication failure looking green, stale bindings can survive, and doctor/status still overstate health without freshness coupling.

risks_found: external operator state could be left half-new after failed install/update
transparent runtime identity values could be silently overwritten by the current shell user
recorded local-bin launch location could drift on update
publication truth, stale artifact precedence, and remote reboot/rebind proof remain incomplete
accepted_fixes: snapshot and restore external operator state on install/update failure
preserve existing transparent runtime UID/GID/exempt UID when valid
reuse the recorded local-bin target when the operator did not override it
add negative-path contract coverage for installer failure, launcher-link failure, and recorded local-bin reuse
rejected_items: broad refactor of runtime publication and discovery paths in the same pass
promoting the July 5 line to pass without remote reboot/rebind proof
treating background auto-reconcile intent as equivalent to healthy publication truth
open_blockers: Start/publication truth is still too optimistic in some auto_reconcile paths and can still look healthier than it is.
Consumer-side stale artifact precedence is still weaker than the verified CLI discovery path in mesh_launch_preflight_auto_bind.sh.
Remote packaged proof is still missing for reboot persistence, post-rebind peer continuity, and live publication recovery on the SSH stand.
